events.name: Bash
events.head: Hash playbook copies and locate mirror
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; shasum workshop-plan/playbook.html app/public/materials/playbook.html; git log -1 --format=%h -- workshop-plan/playbook.html; git status --short workshop-plan/playbook.html app/public/materials/playbook.html; git fetch -q origin main && git diff --stat HEAD origin/main -- workshop-plan/playbook.html app/public/materials/playbook.html | tail -1; ls -d ../tantra-workshop-live* 2>/dev/null; grep -rl "tantra-workshop-live" workshop-plan/build/*.py workshop-plan/ops/*.py 2>/dev/null | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare live mirror copies to source
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log -3 --format='%h %ci %s' -- workshop-plan/playbook.html | cut -c1-140; git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main; git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD; cd /tmp && rm -rf t020m && mkdir t020m && cd t020m && curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/playbook.html?v=$(date +%s)" -o root.html && curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/materials/playbook.html?v=$(date +%s)" -o site.html -w "%{http_code}\n"; sed 's#\.\./walkthroughs/#site/walkthroughs/#g; s#\.\./guides/#site/guides/#g' /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-red

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect root copy asset paths
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t020m; diff root.html rewritten.html | grep -c '^<'; diff root.html rewritten.html | grep '^[<>]' | grep -o 'src="[^"]*"' | sort | uniq -c | head; grep -o 'src="[^"]*guides[^"]*"' root.html | sort -u | head -3; grep -o 'href="[^"]*walkthroughs[^"]*"' root.html | sort -u | head -3; for u in guides/pb-d1/01.webp site/guides/pb-d1/01.webp; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$u %{http_code}\n" https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/$u; done; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "../guides %{http_code}\n" https://adisuja.github.io/guides/pb-d1/01.webp

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check base tag and publish scripts
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t020m; grep -o '<base[^>]*>' root.html; grep -c '\.\./guides/' root.html rewritten.html; grep -c '\.\./walkthroughs/' root.html rewritten.html; grep -rn "tantra-workshop-live" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/ops/*.sh /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/build/*.sh /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls /Users/adithyamurali | grep -i live

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find prior mirror publish commands and holds
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -o 'tantra-workshop-live[^"]\{0,200\}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-020.json workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-297.json 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'clone|cp |git -C|push' | head -8; grep -n "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3

events.text: Checking the mirror: its root playbook has 16 broken screenshot paths (`../guides/` not rewritten), so I'm going to republish it.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find mirror clone path used before
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -oE '(git clone|gh repo clone)[^"\\]{0,160}tantra-workshop-live[^"\\]{0,80}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/*.json | sort -u | head -5; grep -oE '/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]*workshop-live[A-Za-z0-9_./-]*' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-297.json workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-020.json | sort -u | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Clone the mirror repo
events.input: $ cd /tmp && rm -rf twl && git clone -q --depth 5 https://github.com/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live.git twl && cd twl && git log -3 --format='%h %s' | cut -c1-120 && shasum playbook.html site/materials/playbook.html && ls site/guides/pb-d1 | wc -l && ls site/guides/pb-d3 | wc -l

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check whether board sync touches playbook
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 330,400p workshop-plan/tasks/sync_board.py | grep -nE 'playbook|clone|MIRROR|cwd|path' | head; grep -n "playbook" workshop-plan/tasks/sync_board.py | head

events.text: Board sync leaves the playbook alone. Publishing the corrected root copy:

events.name: Bash
events.head: Publish synced root playbook to mirror
events.input: $ cd /tmp/twl && cp /tmp/t020m/rewritten.html playbook.html && git add playbook.html && git commit -q -m "Playbook: root copy synced to main (T-257 screenshot paths rewritten to site/guides/)" && for i in 1 2 3; do git pull -q --rebase origin main && git push -q origin HEAD:main && break; sleep 5; done; git log -1 --format=%h; git status -sb | head -1

events.text: Now the probes, plus a live check once Pages rebuilds.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect probe args and run visual-tools probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; head -40 workshop-plan/probe-playbook.mjs | grep -nE 'argv|URL|env|width' | head; (cd app && node scripts/probe-visual-tools.mjs 2>&1 | tail -3)
